card.title: Gracious Command
card.instruction: Remain warm and appreciative while steadily reducing everyone else’s room to choose.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Thank you for finding reunion venues. My garden will make everyone feel at home.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The hall has shelter if it rains.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Such thoughtful planning. I'll put a gazebo in the garden.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll keep the hall reservation as a backup.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're a lifesaver. Cancel it and put the deposit toward my gazebo; then we're all committed.

mechanism: A warmly praises planning while absorbing alternatives into the garden plan and eliminating the backup.
confusable: Unlike open bossiness, appreciation must accompany each reduction in others' choices.
comparison: D69-a converts a hall deposit into gazebo funding; D69-b converts a wrapping compromise into sole responsibility for fragile packing.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
